WITH quarantined AS (
    UPDATE automation.customer_recovery_events
    SET
        status = 'delivery_unknown',
        last_error = 'Recovery worker lease expired',
        lease_token = NULL,
        lease_expires_at = NULL,
        updated_at = NOW()
    WHERE status = 'processing'
      AND lease_expires_at <= NOW()
    RETURNING event_id
)
SELECT COUNT(*)::integer AS quarantined_count
FROM quarantined;

WITH selected AS (
    SELECT event_id
    FROM automation.customer_recovery_events
    WHERE status = 'pending'
      AND attempts < 5
      AND next_attempt_at <= NOW()
    ORDER BY created_at, event_id
    FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
    LIMIT 10
)
UPDATE automation.customer_recovery_events AS r
SET
    status = 'processing',
    attempts = r.attempts + 1,
    lease_token = gen_random_uuid(),
    lease_expires_at = NOW() + INTERVAL '5 minutes',
    updated_at = NOW()
FROM selected
WHERE r.event_id = selected.event_id
RETURNING
    r.event_id,
    r.organization_id,
    r.customer_id,
    r.customer_email,
    r.refund_amount,
    r.currency,
    r.refund_transaction_id,
    r.lease_token,
    r.payload;

WITH finalized AS (
    UPDATE automation.customer_recovery_events AS r
    SET
        status = 'completed',
        delivered_at = NOW(),
        lease_token = NULL,
        lease_expires_at = NULL,
        last_error = NULL,
        updated_at = NOW()
    WHERE r.event_id = $1::uuid
      AND r.lease_token = $2::uuid
      AND r.status = 'processing'
      AND r.lease_expires_at > NOW()
      AND NULLIF($3::text, '') IS NOT NULL
    RETURNING r.event_id
)
SELECT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM finalized
) AS finalized;

WITH quarantined AS (
    UPDATE automation.customer_recovery_events AS r
    SET
        status = 'delivery_unknown',
        last_error = LEFT($3::text, 1000),
        lease_token = NULL,
        lease_expires_at = NULL,
        updated_at = NOW()
    WHERE r.event_id = $1::uuid
      AND r.lease_token = $2::uuid
      AND r.status = 'processing'
    RETURNING r.event_id
)
SELECT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM quarantined
) AS quarantined;

WITH quarantined AS (
    UPDATE automation.customer_recovery_events AS r
    SET
        status = 'delivery_unknown',
        last_error = 'Gmail accepted message but database finalization was not confirmed',
        lease_token = NULL,
        lease_expires_at = NULL,
        updated_at = NOW()
    WHERE r.event_id = $1::uuid
      AND r.lease_token = $2::uuid
      AND r.status = 'processing'
    RETURNING r.event_id
)
SELECT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM quarantined
) AS quarantined;
